ERR_minCurrentAboveMax: Minimum current must be less than or equal to maximum current
ERR_maxCurrentBelowMin: Maximum current must be greater than or equal to minimum current
LBL_cycleTime: Time between data polls from the charger [ms]
LBL_stateHomeSolarPower: Object ID for the currently available solar power [W]
LBL_stateHomeBatSoc: Object ID for the current state of charge of the home battery [%]
LBL_stateHomePowerConsumption: Object ID for the current home power consumption [W]
LBL_subtractSelfConsumption: Charger consumption is included in the home power consumption value
LBL_chargeManagerReservePower: Grid reserve power kept free instead of charging the car [W]
LBL_chargeManagerMaxBatteryBonus: Maximum battery bonus added to the surplus near 100% SoC [W]
LBL_chargeManagerMinCurrent: Minimum ChargeManager current for PV surplus charging [A]
LBL_maxChargeCurrent: Maximum charging current of the power supply for all wallboxes [A]
LBL_maxChargeCurrentHelp: Installation-wide limit (main breaker / supply). Caps ChargeManager (PV surplus) and ChargeNOW for every wallbox.
LBL_readOnlyMode: Read-only mode - charging release is not sent to the charger (for use with RFID tags)
LBL_batteryModeDisabledDescription: Ignore the home battery; no SOC state is required
LBL_batteryModeMinimumSocDescription: Stop EV charging below the minimum SOC without adding battery power
LBL_batteryModePriorityDescription: Prioritize the battery and gradually release the configured bonus above the minimum SOC
LBL_batterySocHysteresis: Battery SOC hysteresis below the minimum
LBL_batterySocMaxAgeSeconds: Maximum battery SOC age (0 disables the check)
